notes: The hub is now an overlay, not a separate window. Clicking its DungeonHelper toolbar icon opens the whole thing in place — nav list, plugin pages and all — the same way every other plugin's panel appears over the game, instead of launching a window of its own. If you want more room, the ⧉ button in the top right moves it into a floating window and back again; your plugins keep running untouched either way. The plugin list also scrolls now: with a dozen or more plugins the list no longer runs off the bottom. Use the mouse wheel or drag the slim bar on its right edge, and selecting a plugin always brings it into view.
